lineup.verdict: Hold the lineup. Lamar Jackson and Bucky Irving are both Questionable but trending toward playing Sunday; no healthy upgrade beats either on the bench.

trades.verdict: Offer Kirk Cousins to SchoaTime (roster 1) for Tony Pollard. If they say no, offer Cousins to ObiWanless for RJ Harvey instead.

inactives.verdict: Not actionable yet — no NFL game has kicked off. The first Week 4 game is tomorrow night, and the rest of the slate follows Sunday.

actions.message: Saw Baker's out at least three weeks — rough luck, and I know you're stuck starting a running back in your SUPER_FLEX with no real QB behind Purdy. Cousins slots straight in there, and his bye isn't until 13, so he covers every week Baker misses. I'd take Tony Pollard for him — you'd still have Price and Black behind Chase Brown.

evidence.note: Mayfield's MRI showed no ligament damage but he's still out at least three weeks; Jalon Daniels starts for Tampa Bay in Week 4. Pollard remains Tennessee's lead back.

actions.why: SchoaTime starts a RB in SUPER_FLEX with no backup QB; a real QB there outscores that most weeks even after benching Pollard. Better return than RJ Harvey; opens nothing on my calendar.
